tRPC packages upgraded to target versions

nodes.rationale: Range specifiers on @trpc/* allow npm install to silently advance versions, generating lockfiles requiring newer peer deps and causing deploy failures — exact pin closes this

nodes.label: CI lockfile auto-update uses Node 24
nodes.rationale: Node 22 ships npm 10, generating lockfiles incompatible with Docker's npm 11 peer dependency hoisting rules; Node 24/npm 11 fixes this
